acceptance: The per-query profile localizes the overhead to execution-variant recording or exonerates it with a same-host A/B measurement
A fix lands on develop and a later nightly-v2 t3:perf run passes with the 82 ms floor in place
context: Found during nightly-red handoff verification (run 38027036252). The new 82 ms aggregate floor works as designed: it passed the noisy +57.7 ms night and correctly fails this +93 ms night.
description: Nightly-v2 verification run 38027036252 on develop ab0c41b5 measured DuckDB TPC-H SF=0.01 at 640 ms against the 547 ms baseline (+16.97%, +93 ms), failing the aggregate gate even with the new 82 ms floor. The prior night (run 37944292492, 2026-10-09 14:27 UTC) measured 551 ms (+0.66%) on the same AMD EPYC 7763 runner class. The only execution-machinery change between them is #2852 (execution variants in schema 2.3, merged 2026-10-09 23:43 EDT); the per-query profile shows uniform +1-2 ms slowdowns across all 22 queries, consistent with added per-query recording overhead. Local replay with the new floor confirms the failure; artifacts: /tmp names in handoff ledger.
